import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,subprocess,sys,time
root=pathlib.Path('/home/andrew-peterson/.codex/worktrees/stdlib-foundation/laniusc');os.chdir(root)
p=pathlib.Path('tests/fixtures/stdlib_compiler_state/borrowed-enum-referents');s=json.loads((p/'selection.json').read_text());mode=sys.argv[1]
if mode=='freeze':
    names=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-c','-o','--exclude-standard','-z']).split(b'\0')
    names={os.fsdecode(f) for f in names if f and pathlib.Path(os.fsdecode(f)).suffix in {'.rs','.slang','.lani','.bnf','.py','.toml','.lock'}}
    h={f:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in sorted(names) if pathlib.Path(f).is_file()}
    (p/'frozen-sources.json').write_text(json.dumps(h,indent=2)+'\n');print('frozen',len(h));raise SystemExit()
h=json.loads((p/'frozen-sources.json').read_text());changed=lambda:[f for f,v in h.items() if not pathlib.Path(f).is_file() or hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=v]
assert not changed(),changed()
if mode=='library':
    source=pathlib.Path('target/stdlib-perf/build/release/deps/laniusc_compiler-88bea0616d867d66')
    binary=pathlib.Path('target/borrowed-enum-tests/stdlib_gpu_perf');binary.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);binary.unlink(missing_ok=True);os.link(source.resolve(),binary)
elif mode=='native':binary=pathlib.Path('target/stdlib-perf/build/release/deps/compiler_generic_types_execution-443177ec3361c248')
elif mode=='x86':
    match=re.search(r'Executable tests/codegen_x86.rs \((.*?)\)',(p/'build-x86.log').read_text());assert match;source=pathlib.Path(match[1]);binary=pathlib.Path('target/borrowed-enum-x86-tests/stdlib_gpu_perf');binary.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);binary.unlink(missing_ok=True);os.link(source.resolve(),binary)
else:raise SystemExit('unknown mode')
command=[str(binary),*s[mode+'_filters'],'--test-threads=1','--nocapture'];start=time.monotonic()
log=p/(mode+'.log')
with log.open('w') as f:
    try: code=subprocess.run(command,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=90).returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: code=124
raw=log.read_text();r={'command':command,'exit_code':code,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'passed':re.findall(r'^test ([\w:]+) \.\.\. ok$',raw,re.M),'summaries':re.findall(r'test result:.*',raw),'frozen_sources_unchanged':not changed()}
(p/(mode+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r,indent=2));print(raw[-6000:])
